Tomorrow, November 21: Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival at Mana Wynwood in Miami. Rockstar's lineup includes Cactus Jack presents Travis Scott, Cardi B, Metro Boomin, Don Toliver, Tainy and a Justice DJ set across two stages, presented with PlayStation and produced by the creators of III Points. Info: gtavi-thefestival.miami. Who would you see first?
